name: sky130-ldo
description: Loom-managed workspace with AI development orchestration

scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && ./.loom/scripts/check-xschem-embedded-quotes.sh && ./.loom/scripts/check-xschem-duplicate-instance-names.sh
scripts.test: npm run test:compile && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:compile: find sim layout measurements -name '*.py' -not -path 'layout/.venv/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 python3 -m py_compile
scripts.test:unit: python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory sim/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory measurements/tests --pattern 'test_*.py'
scripts.lint: find sim layout measurements -name '*.json' -not -path 'layout/.venv/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 python3 -m json.tool > /dev/null && bash -n sim/bin/pdk-env.sh && bash -n sim/selftest.sh && bash -n layout/bin/setup-venv.sh && bash -n layout/bin/run-trivial-cell-flow.sh && bash -n loom.sh
